summary: Algoritmos de procesado de JSON-LD 1.1 (contexto, expansión, extracción desde HTML) y sus errores. Fija la conformidad de procesadores y serializadores, no la del documento: sirve al método, porque dice qué incumplimiento hace abortar la expansión con qué error y cuál solo produce un aviso o se descarta en silencio.
note: No fija con MUST ni SHOULD condiciones sobre el documento distintas de las de la gramática de w3c-json-ld11, así que no tiene requisitos propios. Sus citas se usan como citas adicionales en los requisitos de w3c-json-ld11.

quotes.text: The key words MAY, MUST, MUST NOT, and SHOULD in this document are to be interpreted as described in BCP 14 [RFC2119] [RFC8174] when, and only when, they appear in all capitals, as shown here.
There are two classes of products that can claim conformance to this specification: JSON-LD Processors, and RDF Serializers/Deserializers.
JSON-LD Processors MUST NOT attempt to correct malformed IRIs or language tags; however, they SHOULD issue validation warnings.
A JSON-LD script element is a script element within an HTML [HTML] document with the type attribute set to application/ld+json.
If source is not a valid JSON document, an invalid script element has been detected, and processing is aborted.

If context cannot be dereferenced, or the document from context document cannot be transformed into the internal representation , a loading remote context failed error has been detected and processing is aborted.
If context is not a map, an invalid local context error has been detected and processing is aborted.

If it is not a string, an invalid default language error has been detected and processing is aborted. If value is not well-formed according to section 2.2.9 of [BCP47], processors SHOULD issue a warning.
If active property is null or @graph, drop the free-floating scalar by returning null.
If expanded property is null or it neither contains a colon (:) nor it is a keyword, drop key by continuing to the next key.
If value is not a string, an invalid @id value error has been detected and processing is aborted.
If value is neither a string nor an array of strings, an invalid type value error has been detected and processing is aborted.
Otherwise, if value is not a scalar or null, an invalid value object value error has been detected and processing is aborted.
Otherwise, set expanded value to value. If value is not well-formed according to section 2.2.9 of [BCP47], processors SHOULD issue a warning.

The result must not contain any entries other than @direction, @index, @language, @type, and @value. It must not contain an @type entry if it contains either @language or @direction entries. Otherwise, an invalid value object error has been detected and processing is aborted.
Otherwise, if the result has an @type entry and its value is not an IRI, an invalid typed value error has been detected and processing is aborted.
The result must contain at most one other entry which must be @index. Otherwise, an invalid set or list object error has been detected and processing is aborted.

If active property is null or @graph, drop free-floating values as follows: - If result is a map which is empty, or contains only the entries @value or @list, set result to null. - Otherwise, if result is a map whose only entry is @id, set result to null.
If expanded output is a map that contains only an @graph entry, set expanded output that value.
